anchor: Exact C163 original fixed-final local step8; never initialize from C168 probes or a selected historical head.

training.free_mask: abs(current coefficient)<=0.125-1e-4; excluded coordinates have direction0; original two-sided coefficient box unchanged
training.active_rule: Every current full84 response_loss>0 row, including zero-gradient rows; no failed-state-only subset
training.LP: max t subject to A_i d+t<=0 for all active rows; A_i is current projected binary64 response gradient divided by its binary64 L2 norm (zero row if norm0); |d_j|<=1 on free coordinates, excluded coordinates0.
training.witness: Use exact rational contractions of every binary64 raw response/guard gradient with the bounded direction. Every active raw dot must be strictly negative before update; report min normalized exact lower bound. This certifies recorded inputs only, not true derivatives, solver optimality, infeasibility or finite acceptance.
training.update: current + fixed1e-4*direction in binary64. Solver vector clipped only to direction bounds and fixed subspace before exact verification; no head clipping, step search, halving, best checkpoint or line search. Empty-active batch has registered zero direction/no LP; unresolved/nonpositive witness stops incomplete and packages, without fallback.
training.guards: Measure/record every current read, KL, radius and regularizer loss and its summed gradient. These do not constrain the response-only LP; no guard-preservation guarantee. Original native hard gates retained at fixed final evaluation.
training.fresh_optimizer_state: No Adam/momentum state; no resumed optimizer

frozen: Original model/revision, LoRA-A, full84 routes, V, prepared/raw coordinates, cached C155 response/logits references and all native thresholds. Only3x2x36 head coefficients updated offline.
references: Original cached C155 FP32 response/logit references, fixed routes/basis/writer/state coordinates, model/revision and zero LoRA-B; original same-anchor replay checks unchanged. No new baseline selection, recentering or calibration.
measurement_order: Native initial84 round0; eight full84 FP64 gradient batches, update after each complete batch; final84 FP64 no-grad; native final round0; native initial round1; native final round1.
sealing: Original constants, initial head, all1092 requests before model initialization. Each current head and84 actual FP64 points before its gradient batch; final step8 before final measurement. Store756 actual FP64 arrays and168 physical FP32 arrays.
replay: Initial native two rounds versus original C168 anchor with unchanged native replay/gate checks; initial FP64 versus original C168 anchor within2e-9 for observed and KL, before first LP/update.
scope: New offline eight-step response-only common-descent LP fit from exact C163 fixed-final step8. Fresh full84 FP64 response and guard scalar gradients at each current head; one LP per active batch, fixed1e-4 coefficient step, exact recorded-gradient sign check before each update, final step8 only. Guard parts/gradients are measured and archived but are not constraints of the response-only LP; actual native gates decide final training qualification. No online correction-free or autonomous-control claim for this fitting procedure. All84 remain exposed training; no fresh confirmation, excluded input, checkpoint/step selection, deployment, convergence, global feasibility or LC2 closure claim. All earlier decisions retained.
